messages:
Marta (Support): Heads up  we're getting tickets: links in the console 'Read docs' open the docs homepage and users can't locate 'rate limits' or 'dedicated capacity' sections.

Ravi (Design): I reproduced. The side panel link is just to /docs/console. We should deep-link to the exact heading. Mobile scroll offset also hides headings under the sticky header.

Leah (Docs): Current pipeline auto-generates anchors from headings which mutate when we tweak copy. That explains broken or mismatched targets.

Ben (A11y): Accessibility concern: deep links need clear, programmatically-available names. Screen readers announce "heading" but not the purpose of the link. Use aria-describedby on landing elements.

Tom - DevEx: Proposal: authors add explicit stable IDs in markdown: e.g. `### Rate limits {#rate-limits}`. Docs build will preserve those IDs and we can link to `/docs/console/usage#rate-limits`.

Aisha (Product): Also let's standardize the in-app label. Console currently shows "Help" but docs say "Documentation". Support KBs mix terms. Pick one. My vote: use "Docs" in the UI and keep full title "Redwood Console docs" on the site.

Leah (Docs): Agree. I'll prepare a tiny lexicon change and update page front-matter. For anchors: kebab-case, lowercase, and avoid changing them unless absolutely necessary.

Ravi (Design): UX details: add an 80px scroll offset when jumping so headings aren't obscured by the fixed nav. Add CSS smooth-scroll and a subtle focus animation to show arrival.

Tom - DevEx: Implementation notes: 1) Add endpoint `/api/docs/anchor-summary?page=usage&anchor=rate-limits` returning {title, excerpt}. Cache 12h. 2) Console will call it to populate the help tooltip instead of loading full doc. 3) If anchor missing return 404 and show toast: "Section moved  opening Console docs home" with a link to search.

Marta (Support): For the toast copy let's add a quick keyboard-friendly close and ensure it is announced by screen readers.

Ben (A11y): Toast should have role="status" and live="polite". Deep link landing element should get `tabindex="-1"` and `focus()` after scroll.

Leah (Docs): Question: do we want to encode version into anchors? I prefer not; we'll use redirects and a stable alias map in the docs site to avoid stale links.

Aisha (Product): Yes, avoid versioning anchors. Add redirects for renamed anchors to maintain link parity. Also include canonical link format in PRs: `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/usage#rate-limits`.

Ravi (Design): Microcopy for the inline link button: "Open docs for this control (new tab)". Tooltip 1-line excerpt + chevron.

Tom - DevEx: I'll implement the anchor-summary API and the fallback toast. Will add unit tests for missing-anchor behavior. Sample curl to test API: ```curl -s "https://console.redwood/api/docs/anchor-summary?page=usage&anchor=rate-limits" | jq .```

Leah (Docs): I'll add explicit IDs to the usage page and a small redirect table for any renamed headings. Also will add examples to docs PR showing canonical links.

Marta (Support): Could we add a KB snippet for support reps with a quick lookup table of common links? I'll draft if you confirm canonical format.

Aisha (Product): Owner check: Leah owns docs-stable-anchors, Tom owns anchor-summary-api, Ravi owns UI-scroll-offset+microcopy, Marta will draft the KB, Ben will review a11y bits. I'll add QA steps to console regression: pick 4 deep links (desktop + mobile) and validate arrival, focus, and SR announcement.

ConsoleHelperBot: Action items recorded: docs-stable-anchors (Leah), anchor-summary-api (Tom), UI-offset-scroll (Ravi), support-kb-links (Marta), a11y-review (Ben), QA-deep-link-tests (Aisha).

Ravi (Design): I'll prototype the offset and the popover microcopy by tomorrow morning.

Leah (Docs): Targeting PR for anchors + redirect map by Friday. Will include CI warnings for missing explicit IDs on headings flagged as linkable.

Tom - DevEx: ETA for API + tests is end of week. I'll add sample responses to the PR so designers can iterate on tooltip content.

Marta (Support): Will draft the KB and ping support for review.

Aisha (Product): Great. Add the QA checklist item and ping me when it's live so we can schedule the console patch release. Thanks everyone.

Ben (A11y): Quick note: include keyboard-only walkthrough in QA steps (open link, land, press tab) so we verify focus behavior.

Leah (Docs): Noted. Closing thread "
